main_text.p: [illegible, ~8 letters]ommune lac coagulare nequeat, imò [illegible, ~3 letters] illud à coagulo confervet, quod ne [illegible, ~6 letters]isticos quidem aut coquos fugit. in-[illegible, ~3 letters]ubitato, uti opinor, argumento fuc-[illegible, ~3 letters]um pancreaticum solum non turgere, [illegible, ~3 letters]ut effervescere, nec solam bilem, [illegible, ~3 letters]um sola in fellis folliculo continetur; [illegible, ~4 letters]hil enim agit in sese: sed utrumque [illegible, ~3 letters]umorem sibi permixtum blandè qui-[illegible, ~3 letters]em effervescere, in statu, videlicet, [illegible, ~3 letters]turali ob dispositionem illorum sub-[illegible, ~3 letters]ontrariam: vehementer verò ob eo-[illegible, ~3 letters]ndem dispositionem præternatura-[illegible, ~3 letters]m & magis contrariam:quod quam-[illegible, ~3 letters]s ex primo experimento fit manife-[illegible, ~3 letters]issimum,remoto tamen instrumento [illegible, ~3 letters]bile liberè per ductū intestinalem in [illegible, ~3 letters]testinum profluente, flaccida paulò [illegible, ~3 letters]te intestina post duas horas enor-[illegible, ~3 letters]iter intumuisse, totumque illud spa-[illegible, ~3 letters]um effervescentiâ distentum fuisse, [illegible, ~3 letters] bullis, quibus, cum aperiretur, sca-[illegible, ~3 letters]bat, palàm constitit. Quæ certè [illegible, ~3 letters]la totum libellum Doctoris LeVas-
